title: International Standard Bible Encyclopedia
author: James Orr (general editor) and contributors
rightsNote: Text public domain (1915). Digital edition: CrossWire Bible Society SWORD module, distributed as public domain.
citation: Orr, James, ed. The International Standard Bible Encyclopedia. Chicago: Howard-Severance, 1915. Public domain; CrossWire SWORD module ISBE 2.2 (TEI).
editorialMarkers: The largest public-domain Bible encyclopedia: signed articles by early twentieth-century evangelical scholars. Names, places, customs and word studies are useful; historical and critical judgments are the contributors’ and dated, and its treatment of African peoples reflects its era.
method: zLD module read directly (index → key → compressed block → TEI entry); TEI reduced to paragraphs; cross-references kept as headwords; scripture references collected from osisRef.
